title: Sözün Sırrı
author: Demet Özdemir
description: Seven years after leaving, Faruk returns to a city that has split into two; old and new. He has changed just as deeply. Caught between staying and leaving, adapting and resisting, loving and letting go, his fragile balance is shattered when time seems to freeze. Confronted with events he never planned for, Faruk must relearn how to move forward; how to grasp the moment, how to look at life from a different angle, and how to unravel the secret power of words. For the mind proves to be an unreliable harbor, and forgetting, time’s cruelest gift, its most beautiful curse. Condemned to forget, humanity has always written to leave traces behind.
